project: Autonomous Agentic BI & Conversational Analytics Platform

epics.name: Enterprise Synthetic Data Warehouse & Benchmark Scenarios
epics.description: Multi-table relational schema (orders, customers, products, geography, order_items, marketing) with calibrated scenarios (Kerala Q2 product churn, regional pricing).

tasks.title: Enterprise Data Warehouse Generator
acceptance_criteria: Generates 8 relational tables (customers, products, geography, orders, order_items, churn_events, marketing_campaigns, calendar_dim)
Calibrated scenario: Kerala state experienced a significant Q2 customer churn concentrated in specific product categories
Outputs clean DuckDB and PostgreSQL compatible datasets with foreign key integrity

epics.name: Canonical Semantic Layer & Governance
epics.description: Entities, metrics, dimensions, grain, allowable join paths, and fanout guards.

tasks.title: Semantic Layer Catalog & Join Graph
acceptance_criteria: Pydantic schemas for Entity, Metric, Dimension, Relationship, and JoinGraph
Canonical metrics: churn_rate, customer_loss_count, net_revenue, average_order_value
Strict allowable join validation preventing join fanout

epics.name: Multi-Engine Database Connectors
epics.description: DuckDB and PostgreSQL connectors with read-only enforcement, execution timeouts, and row limits.

tasks.title: Database Connectors & Read-Only Safety
acceptance_criteria: DuckDB columnar engine and PostgreSQL connector
Strict read-only query execution rejecting mutating operations
SHA-256 result hashing for evidence lineage

epics.name: SQL Generator, AST Validator & Cost Optimizer
epics.description: sqlglot AST parser, grounded SQL generator, mutating statement blocker, and EXPLAIN cost estimator.

tasks.title: SQL AST Validator & Grounded Generator
acceptance_criteria: sqlglot AST parsing blocking DROP, DELETE, UPDATE, INSERT, ALTER
Catalog schema cross-referencing and alias resolution
Grounded query builder mapping semantic metrics to safe SQL
EXPLAIN plan cost estimation and query caching

epics.name: Statistical Profiling & Multi-Dimensional Segmentation
epics.description: Data profiling, inferential stats (t-test, Cohen's d), and shift-share contribution analysis.

tasks.title: Inferential Statistics & Shift-Share Segmentation
acceptance_criteria: Dataset profiler (null rates, cardinalities, distribution moments)
Welch t-test, Mann-Whitney U, Cohen's d effect size, 95% CIs
Multi-dimensional shift-share contribution analysis isolating Kerala product churn

epics.name: Counterargument Agent & Evidence-Sufficiency Gate
epics.description: Independent Critic auditing for Simpson's paradox, confounding, sample size, and explicit refusal.

tasks.title: Critic Agent & Evidence-Sufficiency Gate
acceptance_criteria: Audits for Simpson's paradox, denominator drift, and sample size power
Explicit evidence-sufficiency gate refusing ungrounded claims
Refusal formatted as a successful diagnostic state with required data specifications

epics.name: Evidence Store & Calibrated Claim Verification
epics.description: Immutable SHA-256 evidence records, calibrated multi-factor confidence, and regex claim verifier.

tasks.title: Cryptographic Evidence Store & Verifier
acceptance_criteria: Immutable evidence objects with dataset hash and query definition
Multi-factor calibrated confidence scoring (0.0 to 1.0)
Deterministic citation verifier ensuring every number has an [EVD-...] citation

epics.name: Deterministic Plotly Visualizations & HITL Subsystem
epics.description: Plotly chart specifications (waterfall, time-series anomaly, regional bars) and human review checkpoints.

tasks.title: Visuals Generator & HITL Review Manager
acceptance_criteria: Plotly waterfall chart, time-series anomaly, and regional product churn bar specs
HITL checkpoint evaluating review triggers for high-impact recommendations
Structured review packet generation and approval/rejection handling

epics.name: 16-Stage Pipeline & Conversational Multi-Turn Drill-Down
epics.description: Closed-loop 16-stage pipeline and recursive 'Why?' and 'What should we do?' drill-downs.

tasks.title: 16-Stage Orchestrator & Conversational Drill-Down
acceptance_criteria: Executes full 16-stage pipeline from QUESTION to EVIDENCE_BACKED_ANSWER
Recursive 'Why?' diagnostic driver decomposition
Prescriptive 'What should we do?' counterfactual intervention evaluation

epics.name: Evaluation Framework & Canonical Benchmark Suite
epics.description: Comprehensive benchmark evaluation harness testing SQL accuracy, grounding, citations, and refusal.

tasks.title: Evaluation Harness & Benchmark Scenarios
acceptance_criteria: Canonical business benchmarks: BQ-1 (Kerala Q2 product churn), BQ-2 (Why drilldown), BQ-3 (Intervention), BQ-4 (Refusal)
Scoring harness measuring SQL correctness, citation precision, and task success

epics.name: FastAPI Web Service & Real-Time SSE Streaming
epics.description: REST endpoints for conversational chat, SSE event telemetry, catalog introspection, and HITL approvals.

tasks.title: FastAPI Service & SSE Telemetry Stream
acceptance_criteria: Endpoints for chat queries, SSE event stream, session state, and HITL decision submission
Pydantic v2 schemas and structured error handling

epics.name: React + TypeScript Agentic BI Workspace
epics.description: Power BI-style analytics workspace with ChatGPT-style conversational assistant, Plotly charts, and HITL modal.

tasks.title: React + TypeScript Workspace Frontend
acceptance_criteria: Interactive dashboard with chat input, preset questions (Kerala Q2, Why, What next)
16-stage visual pipeline stepper and live SSE telemetry updates
Interactive Plotly charts, evidence citation popovers, and HITL approval modal

epics.name: Packaging, Docker & AWS Production Deployment Guide
epics.description: Multi-stage Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, Makefile, and enterprise AWS deployment guide.

tasks.title: Docker Setup & AWS Cloud Deployment Guide
acceptance_criteria: Multi-stage Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml
Comprehensive AWS production deployment guide (ECS, RDS, S3)
All unit and end-to-end tests passing
